validity.segment_name: Beihai Tieshan Port loop gas pipe line
validity.recommendation: Keep the row, but replace the current [ref] on Status/Fuel/Capacity/Pressure/Length/Diameter/Location/SegmentCost (the fgw.gxzf.gov.cn generic 2023 work-plan notice) with a project-specific source such as the safety-evaluation registry entry below, which actually names this pipeline and its route.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: this pipeline is real and independently corroborated. It is the '广西天然气支线管网项目铁山港天然气支线管道工程' (Guangxi Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Network Project - Tieshan Port Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Project), built by 广西燃气集团有限公司 (Guangxi Gas Group Co., Ltd.). Independent, separately-run confirmation comes from (1) a Guangxi natural-resources-department land pre-approval registry entry (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn, approved 2024-04-02, project name matches verbatim, land area 2.5441 hectares) and (2) a safety-evaluation-industry disclosure registry (河南油田工程科技股份有限公司's public safety-evaluation-info platform, an entity unconnected to the Guangxi government) which independently names the same project, describes its route (starts at Sinopec's Guangxi Phase-III LNG receiving terminal outer wall, passes a #1 valve chamber / Tieshan Port first station / Nanzhuwan distribution station, ends at Xinggang distribution station) and gives a total pipe length of 3.14km (gas-source connector line) + 25.89km (south loop network) = ~29.0km, evaluated 2023-09 to 2023-12. A third source (an EIA-public-participation notice reprint, yanshougs.com, 2023-10-24) independently names the same project and builder. IMPORTANT SOURCING CAVEAT on GEM's OWN current ref: the cited fgw.gxzf.gov.cn URL (t16217273.shtml) IS a real, live page (confirmed via a 2025-04-13 Wayback snapshot after the live host itself was unreachable from this session), but it is titled '广西壮族自治区发展和改革委员会关于印发《广西能源基础设施建设2023年工作推进方案》的通知' - a generic annual energy-infrastructure work-plan ISSUANCE notice. Its visible body text never names Tieshan Port or this pipeline; any project-specific figures would only live in an attached investment-plan spreadsheet that is not retrievable standalone. This is exactly the 'generic/aggregate citation that does not actually name this pipeline' pattern the sweep is meant to catch - it happens the pipeline itself is real, but the cited ref does not actually support the values it is attached to. CLASSIFICATION: correctly recorded as gas transmission - this is a large-diameter (DN800/DN500 per the route description found), high-pressure branch trunk connecting an LNG import terminal to city-gate distribution stations, not a small gathering/distribution line. DISTINCT-PROJECT WARNING for future researchers: there is a SECOND, textually similar but functionally different pipeline in the same Tieshan Port area - '铁山东港天然气支线管道项目' (Tieshan 'East Port' gas branch pipeline project, serving the 东港产业园区/East Port Industrial Park), originally developed by 广西顺华公司/天圜能源公司 and acquired via a 2024-02-07 equity-transfer signing by Guangxi Energy Group's subsidiaries (广投管网公司, 广投北海燃气公司) - reported by a Chinese energy trade press article. As of that Feb-2024 report it was still awaiting 通气投产 (gas commissioning). This is NOT the same project as P7664 (different developer, different industrial-park framing) and does not appear to be in the 43-row Guangxi roster under any other PID - flagging as a discovery lead for the country's discovery workstream, not folding it into this row. DUPLICATE check against the full roster: no other row names Tieshan Port as start/end, so P7664 is not a relabel of an existing row.

validity.researcher_notes: GEM records Diameter='800/500/400 mm' for this row. Every project-specific route description I located describes only TWO diameters: a DN800 segment (the LNG-terminal-side connector and the first south-loop leg, higher design pressure) and a DN500 segment (the second south-loop leg to Xinggang distribution station, lower design pressure) - consistent with the two design pressures GEM already records (10/6.3 MPa). I found this breakdown on a bidding-information-aggregator reprint (dlztb.com) of the builder's own November-2023 EIA pre-approval public notice, but that specific URL failed url_verifier.py on three separate attempts (ConnectionError each time) and has no Wayback Machine snapshot to fall back on, so per the standing sourcing rule I am NOT citing it as a proposed_ref - I read it manually via curl but cannot certify it through the required tool. No verified source I found states or rules out a 400mm segment either way. Flagging as an open spec concern rather than asserting a confident correction: the '400' may be a stray/erroneous third value, or may correspond to a short tie-in/lateral not covered in the sources I could access. Recommend a follow-up pass with fresh network access to the gxzf.gov.cn family of sites (unreachable from this session - ConnectTimeout on both fgw.gxzf.gov.cn and dnr.gxzf.gov.cn) to pull the actual attached investment-plan/EIA tables.

status_reviews.segment_name: Beihai Tieshan Port loop gas pipe line
status_reviews.researcher_notes: Hunted for evidence newer than the sheet's LastUpdated (2025-08-25). The most recent CONFIRMED milestone I could find is land pre-approval, granted 2024-04-02 (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn registry, verified) - following an EIA public-participation notice (2023-10/11) and a safety-evaluation report submitted 2023-12-12 (hnocse.com registry, verified). That is a coherent pre-construction administrative sequence through April 2024, but I found NO evidence after that date - no groundbreaking/开工 announcement, no 通气/投产 (gas commissioning) report, nothing in general web search for the project's exact name plus 开工/通气/投产/建成/竣工 (multiple query variants tried). April 2024 to now (2026-07-29) is just over 2 years with no further evidenced progress, so applying the dormancy rule: proposed with no progress >=2y -> presumed shelved. This is a presumption from absence of evidence, not a sourced status change - no ref is attached per the standing no-fabricated-ref rule for inferred status changes. Caveat: this project has real institutional backing (provincial gas SOE, LNG-terminal linkage, completed EIA+safety-eval+land-approval steps), so a 'stalled' presumption could be wrong if recent construction news simply didn't surface in this session's searches (this session's web-search budget was exhausted before I could run additional targeted queries, and the gxzf.gov.cn family of government hosts that would carry the most authoritative updates was unreachable - ConnectTimeout - from this sandbox for the entire session). Recommend a follow-up check specifically for 2024-2026 construction/commissioning news before finalizing the shelved presumption.

summary: P7664 is a real, independently-corroborated project (Tieshan Port gas branch pipeline, Guangxi Gas Group) but GEM's own cited ref for most fields is a generic non-project-specific notice; staged two open spec concerns (an unsupported 400mm diameter figure, a ~17%-low SegmentCost figure) that I could not formally verify a correction for, one FuelSource ref fill, and a 'stale->presumed shelved' status-review call given no evidence of progress since April 2024 land approval. UNRESOLVED: the diameter and cost discrepancies (source found but failed url_verifier with no Wayback fallback - needs a fresh-network re-check), and the status presumption itself (network access to the authoritative gxzf.gov.cn hosts was unavailable all session).
